metadata.final_test_requires: Batch2 was already evaluated in the earlier run; no automatic retest in this revision.
metadata.external_batch_context: Batch2 was previously evaluated; this revision uses only Batch1 scores.

split.policy_normalization: strip edges and collapse whitespace; no policy-number rounding
split.input_order: sort by batch and string cell_id before splitting

metadata.cv_aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic mean of five validation-fold scores; R2 averages defined folds only.
metadata.gap_definition: OOF minus full-development train (errors); train minus OOF (R2). Per-fold gaps compare validation with that fold's train.
metadata.train_metrics_scope: Resubstitution on full development, optimistic diagnostics only.
metadata.r2_policy: Null if targets are constant; never force an undefined R2 to 0 or 1.
metadata.negative_prediction_policy: Preserve raw predictions; no clipping; counts and flags exported.
metadata.elasticnet_context: Severson 2019 used a log-life target; this raw-target F1 adaptation is not a replication.
metadata.selection_bias_note: OOF is reused to select features/alpha, so selected OOF is not a final unbiased test.
metadata.input_provenance: MAIN supplies extraction/source version; this module reads no source files.
metadata.upstream_assumption: model_eligible and initial-cycle feature timing are established by MAIN.

model_spec.prediction_input: DataFrame containing exactly feature_names in that order
